statements.statement: Free cash was certified at a final number of $3,354,370, to be used for capital plan and free cash distribution decisions in an upcoming meeting
The FY2027 omnibus budget was voted into the annual town meeting warrant as the base budget, with no figure yet stated
The board placed a placeholder override article on the warrant; all five members have committed to putting some version of a Proposition 2½ override on the ballot, with details still to be worked out
The FY2027 salary administration plan adjustment is a 3% cost-of-living increase, voted for the warrant and recommended for approval
Free cash appropriation to the OPEB Trust Fund (10%) was set at $335,437 and recommended for approval
The most expensive vacation-buyout option, using free cash to buy out 100% of accrued time transition liability across all bargaining units and non-union staff, was calculated at $265,916.17
A cheaper vacation-buyout option, buying out only time over three weeks, was calculated at $56,000; the board did not choose between options yet
The PEG (public education government access) enterprise fund is operating at about a $100,000 deficit for FY27, covered by anticipated revenues and a transfer from reserves
At the March 4th School Committee meeting the updated projected deficit was reported as approximately $1.9 million, down from an earlier $2.4 million figure
Even with the reduced deficit, the district still faced roughly a $900,000 shortfall to fund level services
The select board reiterated it is continuing conversations and supporting a version of an override on the ballot for both the school and town sides
